# Bundled animation runtimes

- `three.min.js`: Three.js 0.160.1, from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.160.1/build/three.min.js . MIT notice included in `THREE-LICENSE.txt`.
- `gsap.min.js`: GSAP 3.13.0, from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/gsap.min.js . Original license header retained; license reference: https://gsap.com/standard-license/ .
- `ScrollTrigger.min.js`: GSAP ScrollTrigger 3.13.0, from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/gsap@3.13.0/dist/ScrollTrigger.min.js . Original license header retained.

Classic script builds are pinned here to preserve the existing directly opened HTML workflow. Three.js logs a deprecation notice for this legacy distribution format. A future module migration should update core and any addons together and verify the hosted build.
- `lenis.min.js`: Lenis 1.1.13 smooth scroll, from https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/lenis@1.1.13/dist/lenis.min.js . MIT.
